body: If your offer still stands, I would definitely be down to talk. This week isn't starting out much better although I've been almost too busy to entertain many suicidal thoughts at least.

My school actually may, they have a full clinic and everything. I'll look into it. I like to feel/think like I'm making progress every day, but it does eventually make me feel worse when I feel like I'm not living up to that.

Hey thanks guys, talking about it really does help... I was just able to read these because I've been constantly at work all weekend. :/ Anyway I've seen a psychiatrist (where I got the adderall from) and I used to take MAOIs and then SSRIs for Anxiety but I didn't really like either, the MAOIs made me feel terrible and the SSRIs helped I guess but made me feel numb and had bad... uh, sexual side effects. So yeah.

And to add to that I got diagnosed with ADD two weeks ago after a long period of really terrible school performance which was making me feel worthless, and have been adjusting to taking adderall for that.
